01 · Class 9

We sat together in Class 9.

Back then, it was simple. We were classmates, we sat together, and we got to know each other. Those little moments became a part of my story.

02 · Class 10

Then things changed between us.

Someone said things that changed how you saw me, and we grew distant. It hurt, because I missed the way things used to be. I couldn’t change everything people said, so I focused on myself and my studies.

0%

Move through the years: from sitting together, to distance, to finding our way back to the same place.

03 · The comeback

I worked hard, and things changed.

Near the end of Class 10, after my academic comeback, you told me you realised someone had manipulated you against me. That helped me understand why things had changed between us.

Now we’re in Class 12, and our paths have crossed again. Choose the feeling for this next part.

04 · For you, Dipti

“Dipti, we met in Class 9 and sat together. Then things went wrong, and we became distant. Near the end of Class 10, after my academic comeback, you told me you realised someone had manipulated you against me. Now we’re in Class 12, and we’ve met again. I’m glad our paths crossed once more.”

I made this little universe because you’re part of a story I remember. I like you, but I don’t want you to feel any pressure. I just wanted to share what this journey has meant to me. Whatever happens next, I’m glad we met.

Made by Ujjwal for Dipti. One honest memory, one shared history, and room for whatever comes next.
